method: Independently read production file-acquisition delta and test process helper; expand existing trusted structural fixture tokens; run real regular/FIFO files and both symlink targets through native CLI with five-second outer deadline.

conclusions: No new external executable dependency or production writes; regular-file symlinks preserve target-size check and verdict.
Windows branch does not evaluate UnixStat or ResolveLinkTarget; APIs in that branch use existing FileInfo/FileAttributes members. Syntax review is not native Windows PowerShell5.1 execution.

Non-Windows UnixStat property and ResolveLinkTarget runtime capability are required. Older Unix runtimes without them are not certified and may reject valid regular/link inputs; source-bound root record now states this limitation.
Check/read is not atomic against a concurrent filesystem type replacement; this is stable-input FIFO rejection, not an all-race acquisition guarantee.

Test helper timeout kills/reaps direct child and disposes handle; stream Result remains potentially unbounded for a descendant retaining inherited pipes. Present validator inputs have no such child-producing path; do not describe this helper as universal descendant supervision.
result: Targeted four-case native behavior accepted with explicit capability/platform/race scope; no three-minute suite rerun.
